title_vi: Chín mẫu kiến trúc cho dòng dữ liệu và giao tiếp: mỗi mẫu trả lời một câu hỏi khác

source_snapshot.note: Pinned commit/path body read through raw.githubusercontent.com at the pinned commit and hashed as a Git blob; computed OID matches the source map. Non-empty source was read; no source-image bytes used.

claims.claim_vi: The source names nine patterns: Peer-to-Peer, API Gateway, Pub-Sub, Request-Response, Event Sourcing, ETL, Batching, Streaming Processing, Orchestration.
claims.verified_by: Source body read at the pinned commit; only the names are used.

claims.claim_vi: Each pattern answers a different question (communication/coordination versus data flow) and has its own cost, e.g. an API gateway becomes a point needing redundancy, pub-sub makes completion hard to observe, batching adds latency.
claims.verified_by: General knowledge of the author, not checked against an official document: the writing environment could only reach GitHub, and no official document for this topic is hosted there.

design_notes_vi: Hai khung ghi chú: năm mẫu giao tiếp và phối hợp, bốn mẫu về dữ liệu.
source_deviations: Source lists nine patterns in one sequence; the lesson keeps the names and groups them into two sets by the question they answer, adding the cost of each.
Orchestration is placed with the communication set by the author.
